memory_update.text: Primary Layer 1B candidates for the enterprise agentic software/data/security node: NOW, CRM, PLTR, SNOW, MSFT.

The strongest investable mapping is not generic LLM access; it is ownership of workflow surfaces, enterprise data context, permissions, identity, auditability and governance needed to move AI agents into production.

Identity/security pure plays such as OKTA and CRWD showed relevant evidence for AI-agent identity, non-human identity governance and agentic SOC workflows, but were excluded due to the 5-candidate cap; they should be reviewed in a focused identity/security sub-pass.

Other plausible but lower-priority candidates for later passes include ORCL, ADBE, DDOG, MDB, ESTC, CFLT, PATH, TEAM, WORK-equivalent private/owned assets, and AI governance specialists; inclusion should depend on measurable AI revenue, paid adoption, and production deployment evidence.

node: Enterprise agentic software, workflow automation, data platforms, identity and AI governance
summary: Expanded universe for the enterprise agentic software/data/security node. The strongest direct public-company exposures are platforms already embedded in systems of record, workflow orchestration, enterprise data context, identity/governance, or regulated operational deployment. This pass prioritizes ServiceNow, Salesforce, Palantir, Snowflake, and Microsoft as above-$1B US-listed leaders with visible AI-agent productization or governance/control-plane relevance. No buy/sell view is implied.
